The function needs to implement semi-implicit Euler integration, which means updating velocity first using acceleration and gravity, then using that updated velocity for position updates.

Looking at the existing code patterns in the repository, particularly in the GPU kernel code, I can see that gravity is applied as a constant acceleration in the y-direction (negative g value).
